verdict.rationale: Portkey exposes a fully documented REST API (base URL https://api.portkey.ai/v1) with OpenAI-compatible headers, plus an API-reference site covering gateway, logs, budgets, and model catalog endpoints — clearly enabling programmatic/agentic control. Missing for 10: no publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (openapi probes 404) and no independent third-party confirmation of API robustness.
